newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr closes stronger in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr closes stronger in heavy trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed stronger at C$1.3627 (US$0.7339) from in very heavy trading, from Thursday's close at C$1.3676 (US$0.7312), breaking through key technical levels. * The currency was bolstered by confidence that U.S. interest rates will remain stable and Canadian economic fundamentals are strong, dealers said.
Market players are relieved the U.S. Federal Reserve did not move to raise interest rates last week, but they are still nervous about the Fed raising rates in November, Gregory said.
The market is also concerned the Bank of Canada may cut rates in the next couple of weeks, undermining the recent strength the in the currency, dealers said.
"The Canadian dollar is not out of the woods. Temporarily it is, but I think it's still rangebound," Gregory said.
The Canadian dollar will likely strengthen again on Monday after Statistics Canada releases gross domestic product numbers for July, Gregory said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1178 marks from Thursday's close of 1.1135 marks and rose to 81.26 yen from 80.86 yen.
